snippet.title: Make my Sandwich — Official Game Trailer (Cozy Puzzle Game)
snippet.description:
Official trailer for "Make my Sandwich" — a cute, tactile, and relaxing puzzle game where every sandwich is a little masterpiece crafted with care! 🍞✨

Inhale the aroma of fresh bread and become the ultimate sandwich artist! Read the customer order cards carefully, decode their unique preferences, diets, or allergies, and drag the ingredients onto the cutting board layer by layer. Whether they want something light without fish, or a specific seed bread with no cheese, your goal is to listen and create the perfect combination.

🎮 Play the Free Demo & Add to wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4605240/Make_my_Sandwich/
🚀 Coming August 5, 2026!
🌟 Explore our full collection: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45978844

Game Features:
🍅 Care in Every Card: Solve customer requests by managing their dietary needs and preferences;
🧀 Tactile Assembly: Enjoy satisfying drag-and-drop gameplay as you stack fresh ingredients;
🥤 Rich Variety: Dozens of beautifully hand-drawn food items, from different breads to meat, fish, and refreshing drinks;
🎨 Cozy & Relaxing: Charming art style and serene music with no timers or rushing;
💖 Pure Aesthetic Bliss: The perfect game to unwind, destress, and appreciate beautiful food.

Subscribe for more updates, trailers, and upcoming cozy releases!
📬 Contact us: owlshowls.steam@gmail.com
